hooks.command: r=$PWD; while [ -n "$r" ] && [ ! -e "$r/.specnaut/hooks" ] && [ ! -L "$r/.specnaut/hooks" ]; do r=${r%/*}; done; [ "$( (sha256sum 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256) < "$r/.specnaut/hooks/SHA256SUMS" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-64)" = "1f418a8c9295bdbaa4cdf4fd7047eeff0809b506c0269c40f46d0ec9f5781f75" ] && (cd "$r/.specnaut/hooks" && (sha256sum -c --status SHA256SUMS 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256 -c --status SHA256SUMS)) && exec bash "$r/.specnaut/hooks/protect-generated.sh" codex; echo "specnaut: .specnaut/hooks changed since it was trusted — run specnaut upgrade, then /hooks" >&2; exit 2
